responsibility: Defines regression tests for `rustc_index` newtype index behavior, validating the niche-based layout guarantees of `newtype_index!` types and the correctness of range iteration APIs over those index types, including forward and reverse traversal, element counts, and size hints.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `tests.rs` files, this one does not test set data structures at all; it targets the `newtype_index!` machinery used by `rustc_index::vec`, especially niche-optimized layout and iteration over index ranges. Its scope is index newtypes and their range APIs, not bitset representations or interval-set merging behavior.
